title: Extremely high resistance (5000+)
symptom: Transmitters are not lasting the full 3 months; one died after 72 days. A new transmitter out of the box shows resistance of 5888, and the previous transmitter's last reading was 8264. These values are much higher than the typical ~1000 neighborhood.
cause: Dexcom changed something with the 8G+ transmitter giving higher resistance values; the temperature reporting format changed with a Dexcom transmitter firmware update, making reported temperature and resistance incorrect.
fix: No fix provided; the issue was closed because with recent releases of xDrip, those two parameters (temperature and resistance) have been removed until the correct format is implemented.
evidence_quote: The temperature reporting format changed with a Dexcom transmitter firmware update. The reported temperature and resistance, for the same reason, have been incorrect. With recent releases of xDrip, those two parameters have been removed until the correct format is implemented.
